---
name: Documentation improvement
about: Suggest a documentation fix, clarification, or addition
title: "docs: "
labels: documentation
---

## What document

Which file or section needs improvement? Link to it if possible.

## What's wrong or missing

Describe the issue: typo, outdated information, missing content, confusing wording, broken link.

## Suggested improvement

If you have a specific suggestion, describe it here. If not, that's fine — identifying the problem is the valuable part.

## Scope

- [ ] This is a fix to existing documentation (typo, broken link, outdated info).
- [ ] This is a new documentation page or section.
- [ ] This affects the public docs in `docs/`.
- [ ] This affects contributor docs (`CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CONTRIBUTOR_GUIDE.md`, etc.).

## Additional context

Screenshots, links to related docs, or anything else that helps.
